name: International Atomic Energy Agency
description: A UN-blue field charged at the centre with the IAEA emblem in white: a Bohr atom — a central dot with orbiting electron paths — flanked by two olive branches.
history: The IAEA was founded in 1957 as the world's 'Atoms for Peace' organization within the UN family; its flag places the agency's atom-and-olive-branches emblem, adopted in 1960, on the UN's light blue.

features.symbolism: the peaceful use of nuclear energy, framed by the UN olive branches of peace
